title: Page 10
content_zh:
「本王明白，你可以退下了。」
「是。」
使者离去之后，兰霆一个人在御书房内喜不自胜，脸上的笑容久久不散，心情是前所未有的畅快欢悦。
他和雪莹重聚的日子终于要到来了，他早已迫不及待，真想下一刻就能见到她。
她终于要回到他身边了，这一次，不管发生任何事情，他都要紧紧抓着她，与她形影不离……
等待的日子又过了一个月，兰霆每日还是忙于国事当中，一刻都不得闲，只有待在暖芳阁的时候，他才有放松的感觉，能够暂时地喘上一口气。
忙完国事后，天色已暗下，像往常一样，他踏进到暖芳阁里，然而他才刚踏入殿阁里一步，就发现今晚阁里似乎有些不同。
难道雪莹已经回来了？算算时间也差不多一个月，他有一种很强烈的感觉，她似乎就在伸手可到之处，不再遥不可及了。
他瞧向一旁负责打理暖芳阁的宫女，努力压抑自己激动的情绪。「雪莹回来了吗？」
宫女们漾着笑，还没答话，他已心急地往房内走去，打算自己寻找答案。
她到底在哪里？他四处张望，却始终没有见到那令人想念的身影，一直到他进到内房里，还是什么都没发现，房内依旧静悄悄的，连半点声音都没有。
是他的错觉？难道他已经想她想到开始出现幻觉，以为她真的回来了？他不由得失笑出声，原本的期待瞬间落空，让他惆怅不已。
「雪莹……」他落寞地轻唤着，到底要等到什么时候，才会有人回应他，他才不再感到寂寞难耐？
这样磨人椎心的等待还得持续到什么时候？他想见她，好想好想，已经想得快要发狂了……
此时，一双纤细的手无声地从后悄悄环抱住他，让他整个人震愣住，那一双手覆上他的心口，感受到他激动狂跳的心，越来越快，早已不受控制。
一股淡淡的清香袭来，他的背脊和她紧紧相靠着，那熟悉的亲密温暖让他瞬间热泪盈眶，几乎不敢相信这是真的。
她终于回来了，谢天谢地，她终于回到他身边了……
他紧握住她放在他心上的手，像是怕下一瞬间她就会消失无踪，然后缓缓地转过身，将她仔细地看个清楚。
她原本憔悴的神色已不复见，原本凹陷的脸蛋丰润了不少，始终黯淡的肤色也明亮起来，就连泛白的嘴唇也转而浮现淡淡桃红色泽，教他心慰又欢喜。
宗雪莹漾起灿烂的笑容，落下感动欣慰的泪水，语带哽咽地说：「我回来了……」

她终于熬过病痛、熬过无尽的相思，重新回到他身边了。她归心似箭，在娘亲点头后，她立刻动身，只想用最快的时间回来，结束两人的相思煎熬。
看着他激动欣喜的神情，她知道他等得很辛苦，她同样也是，现在她回来了，回到他的身边，相信经过这次几近生离死别的痛苦分离后，他们会更珍惜往后相处的每一点时光，及这份生死相许的难得缘分。
兰霆俯下身将她紧抱在怀里，激动的泪终于滑下两颊，心中的狂喜难以言喻。
「回来了，就不准你再离开，知道吗？」他的嗓音同样哽咽。「你只能留在我身边，直到白发苍苍，我都不会再放你走了。」
生离和死别一样痛苦，他们经历过生离，也差点得面对死别，好不容易才又相守在一起，他不会再让两人有任何离别的机会，接下来的日子，两人要形影不离，生死相依。
「不走了，不管再发生什么事，我都不会离开你了……」宗雪莹也紧紧地回抱住他，许下承诺，此生此世，他在哪儿，她就会在哪儿，两人再也不要分开。
这就是他们的缘分，缠缠绕绕，越缠越紧密，再也没有任何阻碍能将他们俩分开……
晨光映入宁静的寝殿里，铺着龙凤绣纹锦被的床上，兰霆和宗雪莹亲密地相依而眠，就连睡着了也舍不得分开。
兰霆习惯早起，所以天亮不久，他就从沉睡中醒来，却不想马上起身更衣，只是静静地瞧着怀中人儿的睡颜，怎么瞧都瞧不腻。
他勾起温柔的笑容，轻轻地在她的额上印下一吻，能够一早醒来就瞧见她依偎在自己身旁，他的心很暖、很满足，还真舍不得下床离她而去。
就在两个月前，他正式立她为后，两人虽然早已相识超过十年，却依旧如胶似漆，除了上朝，两人几乎是形影不离。
「王。」宫女看时辰差不多，便进到房里，打算替兰霆更衣，准备上朝。
兰霆有些懊恼地微蹙起眉，宗雪莹依旧在他的怀中睡得香甜，他真的非常不愿意起身，但也只能百般无奈地放开她，离开软玉温香，准备上朝去。
他已经很小心轻悄地下床，不想将她吵醒，没想到床畔一空下来，宗雪莹就马上转醒，睡眼惺忪地撑坐起身。「霆，你要上朝了？怎么不唤醒我？」
「你要是困就继续睡，不必这么早起身。」兰霆又回到床边，爱怜地轻抚她红润的脸蛋，她的气色是越来越好了。
「不行，说好了我要亲自帮你更衣的。」她摇摇头，努力让自己快点清醒，还是执意要下床。
宫女将朝服一一捧出，就站在一旁，宗雪莹从宫女手中接过衣裳，开始一件件帮兰霆穿上，脸上有着幸福的笑意。
在平民百姓间，妻子帮自己的丈夫更衣是一种甜蜜的闺房之趣呀，所以她也要亲自帮心爱的丈夫更衣，和他甜甜蜜蜜。
她拿起镶玉的腰带，环过他的腰，替他把腰带扣起，没想到他却乘机将她抱个满怀，埋首在她的肩颈处，暧昧地轻轻磨蹭着。
「你……正经一点。」她羞红着脸轻斥。「就要上朝了，别胡来，一旁还有宫女在看。」

看到兰霆瞪过来的视线，宫女们非常识相地赶紧低下头，她们什么都没看见，也什么都没听见。
「雪莹，你真香……」他故意在她耳旁低喃，存心挑逗她。「你到底抹了些什么，怎么总是让我闻不腻，甚至是上了瘾？」
她身上有种淡淡的香甜气息，清新自然，那不是任何脂粉的味道，是属于她的独特气息，让他贪恋沉迷。
「你只是在找藉口轻薄我。」她娇睨了他一眼，赶紧推开他，免得他做出更让人脸红心跳的举动来。
宗雪莹想退开，兰霆可没让她如愿，依旧将她的腰扣得紧紧，逃不开他的臂弯。「咱们是夫妻，恩爱是天经地义的事，又怎能说是轻薄？」
「在床上也就罢了，在众人面前你也这样，我都不知该拿什么脸面对……」
「哦，你的意思是，在床上咱们就可以肆无忌惮了？」
「呃？啊——」兰霆突然将她打横抱起，她赶紧圈住他肩颈，不解地问：「你想做什么？」
「当然是照你的意思，回床上去肆无忌惮。」他勾起淡笑，笑得颇为暧昧。
「我……我才不是这个意思……」她害羞得赶紧解释。「在不在床上是其次，你现在该要上朝，所以不该再和我……唔……嗯……」
他一将她放回床上，俯身吻住她喋喋不休的唇，恣意品尝她唇中的甜美，才不管她到底是什么意思。
她嘤咛了几声，想阻止却阻止不了，反过来被他火热的吻给迷醉了心魂，情不自禁地回应着他，什么都不顾了。
暧昧的气息越来越浓烈，热情一发不可收拾，此时太监远远的在门边轻咳一声，低垂着头，大着胆子打断房里的无边春意。「咳，王……上朝的时辰到了。」
content_en:
"I understand, you can retreat."
"Yes."
After the envoy left, Lan Ting was overjoyed alone in the imperial study. The smile on his face lingered for a long time, and his mood was unprecedentedly joyful.
The day for him and Xueying to be reunited was finally coming, and he couldn't wait for it. He really wanted to see her next moment.
She is finally coming back to him. This time, no matter what happens, he will hold her tightly and be inseparable from her...
Another month of waiting has passed, and Lan Ting is still busy with state affairs every day, never having a moment to spare. Only when he stays in Nuanfang Pavilion can he feel relaxed and be able to take a breath temporarily.
After finishing his business, the sky had darkened. As usual, he stepped into Nuanfang Pavilion. However, as soon as he took a step into the pavilion, he found that there seemed to be something different in the pavilion tonight.
Could it be that Xueying has come back? Calculating the time, it was almost a month, and he had a strong feeling that she seemed to be within reach and no longer out of reach.
He looked at the palace maid who was taking care of Nuanfang Pavilion and tried to suppress his excitement. "Is Xueying back?"
The maids smiled, but before they could answer, he walked anxiously into the room, planning to find the answer himself.
Where is she? He looked around, but never saw that missing figure. Until he entered the inner room, he still found nothing. The room was still quiet, not even a sound.
Is it his illusion? Could it be that he had missed her and started hallucinating, thinking she was really back? He couldn't help but laugh out loud. His original expectations were instantly shattered, making him melancholy.
"Xueying..." He whispered lonelyly. When will he wait until someone responds to him and he will no longer feel lonely and unbearable?
How long will this excruciating wait continue? He wanted to see her, he wanted to see her so much that he was almost going crazy...
At this time, a pair of slender hands quietly hugged him from behind, making him stunned. Those hands covered his heart, and he could feel his excited and wildly beating heart, which was getting faster and faster, and was no longer under his control.
A faint fragrance hit her, and his back was pressed tightly against hers. The familiar warmth of intimacy made him burst into tears instantly, and he could hardly believe that this was real.
She is finally back, thank God, she is finally back with him...
He held her hand on his heart tightly, as if he was afraid that she would disappear without a trace in the next moment, and then slowly turned around to take a closer look at her.
Her original haggard expression was gone, her originally sunken face became much plumper, her always dull skin tone became brighter, and even her pale lips turned a light pink color, which made him feel relieved and happy.
Zong Xueying smiled brightly, shed tears of joy, and said with a choked voice: "I'm back..."
She finally got over her illness and endless lovesickness, and returned to him. She was eager to return home, and after her mother nodded, she immediately set off, hoping to come back as quickly as possible to end the torment of lovesickness between the two of them.
Looking at his expression of excitement and joy, she knew that he had been waiting very hard, and so did she. Now that she was back, back to him, she believed that after this painful separation of almost life and death, they would cherish every moment of time together in the future, and this rare fate of life and death.
Lan Ting leaned down and held her tightly in his arms, tears of excitement finally slid down his cheeks, and the ecstasy in his heart was indescribable.
"Once you come back, you are not allowed to leave again, do you understand?" His voice was also choked with sobs. "You can only stay with me until your hair turns gray, and I will never let you go again."
Separation in life is as painful as separation in death. They have experienced separation in life and almost had to face separation in death. They finally stayed together again. He will not let the two of them have any chance to say goodbye again. In the following days,The two must be inseparable and depend on each other for life and death.
"I won't leave. No matter what happens again, I will never leave you..." Zong Xueying hugged him back tightly and made a promise that wherever he is in this life, she will be there, and the two of them will never be separated again.
This is their fate, entwined and entangled, getting tighter and tighter, and there is no obstacle that can separate them...
The morning light shone into the quiet bedroom. On the bed covered with dragon and phoenix embroidered brocade quilts, Lan Ting and Zong Xueying slept closely together, reluctant to separate even when they fell asleep.
Lan Ting was used to getting up early, so he woke up from his deep sleep not long after dawn, but he didn't want to get up and change clothes immediately. He just quietly looked at the sleeping face of the person in his arms, and he never got tired of looking at it.
He raised a gentle smile and pressed a gentle kiss on her forehead. Being able to wake up early in the morning and see her nestled next to him made his heart feel warm and satisfied, and he really couldn't bear to get out of bed and leave her.
Just two months ago, he officially made her his queen. Although the two have known each other for more than ten years, they are still inseparable. Except for going to court, the two are almost inseparable.
"King." The maid saw that it was almost time, so she entered the room and planned to change Lan Ting's clothes before going to court.
Lan Ting frowned slightly in annoyance. Zong Xueying was still sleeping soundly in his arms. He was really reluctant to get up, but he had no choice but to let her go, leave Nephrite Wenxiang, and prepare to go to court.
He had already gotten out of bed very carefully, not wanting to wake her up. Unexpectedly, as soon as the bed was empty, Zong Xueying immediately woke up and sat up sleepily. "Ting, are you going to court? Why don't you wake me up?"
"If you are sleepy, just go back to sleep. There is no need to get up so early." Lan Ting returned to the bedside and caressed her rosy face lovingly. Her complexion was getting better and better.
"No, I agreed that I would help you change in person." She shook her head and tried to wake up quickly, but still insisted on getting out of bed.
The maid held out the court clothes one by one and stood aside. Zong Xueying took the clothes from the maid's hands and began to help Lan Ting put them on one by one, with a happy smile on her face.
Among ordinary people, it is a sweet boudoir pleasure for a wife to help her husband change his clothes, so she should also help her beloved husband change his clothes personally and be sweet with him.
She picked up the jade-encrusted belt, put it around his waist, and buckled it up for him. Unexpectedly, he took the opportunity to hold her in his arms, burying his head in her shoulders and neck, rubbing it gently and ambiguously.
"You...be more serious." She scolded with a blush. "It's time to go to court. Don't act recklessly. There are maids watching from the side."
Seeing Lan Ting's glare, the maids quickly lowered their heads knowingly. They saw and heard nothing.
"Xueying, you smell so good..." He deliberately whispered in her ear, deliberately teasing her. "What on earth have you put on it? Why do I never get tired of smelling it? I'm even addicted to it?"
There was a faint sweet smell on her body, fresh and natural. It was not the smell of any makeup, but her own unique smell, which made him addicted to it.
"You're just looking for an excuse to be scornful of me." She gave him a cute look and quickly pushed him away to prevent him from doing something even more embarrassing.
Zong Xueying wanted to move away, but Lan Ting didn't let her do so. He still held her waist tightly, making it impossible to escape from his arms. "We are husband and wife, and love is a matter of course. How can we call it frivolous?"
"That's it in bed. You behave like this in front of everyone. I don't know how to face it..."
"Oh, you mean, we can be unscrupulous in bed?"
"Huh? Ah -" Lan Ting suddenly picked her up and she quickly wrapped her arms around his shoulders and asked puzzledly: "What do you want to do?"
"Of course I will do what you want, go back to bed and do whatever you want." He gave a faint smile, which was quite ambiguous.
"I...that's not what I meant...” She was so shy that she quickly explained. "Whether or not you are in bed is the second priority. You should go to court now, so you shouldn't be with me anymore... um... um..."
As soon as he put her back on the bed, he leaned over and kissed her chattering lips, savoring the sweetness of her lips without caring what she meant.
She squeaked a few times and tried to stop him but couldn't. Instead, she was intoxicated by his passionate kiss and couldn't help but respond to him without caring about anything.
The ambiguous atmosphere became stronger and stronger, and the enthusiasm was out of control. At this time, the eunuch coughed lightly by the door from a distance, lowered his head, and boldly interrupted the boundless spring in the room. "Ahem, King...it's time to go to court."
